title: Constant/completed coefficient transport preserves completed tensor and adjunction normalization
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $A$, a uniformizer $t$, and $A_n=A/(t^n)$, $n\ge1$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be any morphism of schemes on which $\ell$ is invertible, using small pro-etale sites [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Put $R_W=\lim_n(A_n)_W$ and let $\underline A_W$ be the constant ring sheaf [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients, def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Work in ordinary unbounded module-sheaf derived categories, with exact coefficient restriction $U_W:D(R_W)\to D(\underline A_W)$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category, def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars]. Let $C^R_W,C^A_W$ be the Koszul derived-completion reflectors with their actual units $\eta^R,\eta^A$; identify them with total limit of the strict finite-reduction towers by [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-koszul-completion-reflector, lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence]. Write $\widehat\otimes_R,\widehat f_R^*$ for the quotient-tower tensor and pullback [def-pur-integral-derived-operations]; on constant coefficients put $M\widehat\otimes_A N=C^A_W(M\otimes^L_{\underline A_W}N)$ and $\widehat f_A^*=C^A_Xf^{-1}$. Ordinary direct images are $F_R=Rf_{*,R}$ and $F_A=Rf_{*,\underline A}$, and $\kappa:U_YF_R\xrightarrow{\sim}F_AU_X$ is the canonical derived-composition comparison [lem-pur-completed-coefficient-pushforward-comparison]. Completed adjunctions use the ordinary adjunction followed by the completion-reflector Hom bijection [lem-sbc-reflector-adjunction-unit-formulas].

On derived-complete inputs there are specified natural isomorphisms
$$a_{M,N}:U_W(M\widehat\otimes_R N)\xrightarrow{\sim}U_WM\widehat\otimes_A U_WN,\qquad b_H:\widehat f_A^*U_YH\xrightarrow{\sim}U_X\widehat f_R^*H.$$
They are induced on the whole strict quotient systems by derived tensor reassociation, the finite change-of-rings comparisons and the scalar-unit map $x\mapsto1\otimes x$, respectively, before total limit; their iterated versions are the substitution comparisons of [lem-pur-completed-operation-tower-substitution]. The maps $a$ identify the completed tensor associators, unitors and symmetry, and $b$ respects tensor/pullback comparisons and composition of pullbacks. Both identify the actual completion units under $U$.

The comparisons $b,\kappa$ identify the specified completed adjunctions, not just the two pairs of functors. Explicitly, if $\varepsilon_R^c,\varepsilon_A^c$ are their counits, for every complete $M\in D(R_X)$ one has
$$U_X(\varepsilon^c_{R,M})\circ b_{F_RM}=\varepsilon^c_{A,U_XM}\circ\widehat f_A^*(\kappa_M).$$
The corresponding Hom bijections and units agree under $U$. The ordinary comparison underlying $b$ is the map $\tau:f^{-1}U_Y\to U_XLf_R^*$ of [lem-pur-ringed-coefficient-restriction-counit]; the equality is normalized by $\varepsilon^c\circ\eta_{Lf^*M}=\varepsilon$, so that it refers to these counits. No boundedness, constructibility or Tor-amplitude hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Apply the normalized construction theorem to obtain Transport with ExpressionSystemLaw and ExpressionSystemStructuralLaw, retaining its actual completion-unit and adjunction normalizations.

Prove substitution by induction on expressions: identities give inputs and units; tensorator naturality combines the tensor cases; naturality of b gives pullback. Prove structural coherence by induction on StructuralMap: monoidal associativity and unitality, the braided square and b_composition handle generators; functoriality, naturality and cancellation of invertible maps handle contexts, composites and inverses. Combine these two identities with the constructed system laws.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q53-b9e0e399f (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the item and all 11 steps in full, plus the statement of each of the 13 cited nodes. The delivery has no new nodes. Statement, stmt_deps, source and blueprint match the node as Q67 created it, so nothing was weakened. proof_deps equals the union of the step uses, and there is no cycle and no SGA citation. The Stacks tags 099I/099K (algebraization.tex:1427/1481), 0A0E, 099M, 093M and 07A4 all resolve. I also read the final paragraph of the main-20261015 lem-fix-operation-reduction proof, which is where this item comes from. Hypotheses check out: the constant-completion equivalence needs a small site, a Noetherian ring and a finitely generated ideal, and here A=O_E with I=(t) on the small pro-étale site satisfies all three. Flat-restriction K-flatness needs the ring map to be flat, and the flatness of Â over A comes from step 1 in the right direction. I checked θ_n on representatives: (UP⊗_A UQ)⊗A_n = (P/t^n)⊗_{B_n}(Q/t^n). This holds because R/t^nR = B_n, even though P⊗_A Q and P⊗_R Q differ before reduction. In step 5 the direction of b and the identity b·η^A = U(η^R)·τ follow from the pullback clause of the equivalence node, whose finite reductions are the inverses of the isomorphisms it displays. In step 8 the hypotheses of the ringed counit lemma (any A-algebras, the same κ normalization, x↦1⊗x) match exactly. The prime p in the pushforward node is used nowhere, so it can be chosen different from ℓ. In step 9 the reflector-adjunction formula applies: the Koszul reflector supplies the universal property, and both F_R and F_A preserve complete objects. In step 10 the unit cancellation is correct: the source is exactly C^A(Q_A U F_R M) and the target U_X M is complete. Step 11 then gives the Hom bijections and units. One minor remark, not a fault: the statement does not spell out the constant-side associator. Step 6 fixes it on the same systems, and since every map is unit-compatible, that choice agrees with the canonical one characterized by the completion units. I found no duplicate after searching the cbc/sf/pur constant-coefficient nodes. All declared tool_uses are generic and accepted. Edge cases tested: empty X, f=id, n=1, zero inputs, the unit system, and complexes unbounded in both directions.
